fullText.simplified:
第29章、抓住他

    变装成周局长的藏花开枪打碎了装佛像的玻璃柜，然后飞快地往楼下跑去了。
    楼下马上响起一片碰撞声和惊叫声：“周局长，怎么了？谁开的枪？”
    “是藏花！藏花跑了！快去追！”
    混乱中，一群人看到周局长在向外跑，他们也没弄清楚发生了什么事，就跟着向外跑。但刚跑到院门口，又是一声“砰”响，有人站在院子外面开枪了！
    大家站住了一看，院子外面开枪的也是周局长！
    每个人都愣住了，他们前面站着一个周局长，院子外面也站着一个周局长，两个周局长！
    包厚安已经追了出来，他跑到人群前，指着院子里的这个周局长大声喊：“抓住他！他是藏花！”
    这一声喊让大家清醒了，“他是藏花，抓住他！”大家也大喊着，一起扑上去抓藏花。
    “小心，他有枪！”包厚安也冲了过去。
    十多个人和藏花打成一片，叫喊声也响成一片。混乱中，又是“砰”地一声，打成一片的人群中传出一声枪响，扑打在一起的人马上后退着散开了。
    散开后的空地上，藏花站在那儿。他右手拿着枪，左手抓着一个人，枪指在那个人的头上，大声说：“所有人让开，不然我就开枪了！”
    他抓的人是包厚安。他在混乱中抓住了包厚安。
    散开的警察们措手不及地愣住了，你看看我，我看看你，不知道怎么办。
    白林站在远处，大声说：“藏花！如果包厚安伤了一根头发，你要用命来还！”
    院子外面的周局长也气极了，大声喊：“藏花，你放开他！”
    藏花笑了笑，没有说话，他一手抓着包厚安，一手握着枪，往院子外面走去。
    包厚安的脸是红色的，因为紧张，也因为兴奋。现在藏花就在身边，离得这么近，这是最好的抓他的机会！在对手没有防备的情况下出其不意地进攻，让对手措手不及，这是藏花最喜欢做的事情，现在也是包厚安最想做的事情。
    包厚安深吸一口气，用力撞向藏花，然后飞快地转身扑向他！
    藏花一愣，想往后躲，但已经来不及了。他被撞得后退了几步，还没站稳又被包厚安扑倒了，两个人一起倒在了地上。藏花急红了脸，想推开包厚安，但包厚安死死地将他抱住了。枪还握在藏花手里，但他只是握着，并没有开枪。
    周围的人也扑了上来，有人抓手，有人抓脚，将藏花死死地按住了。
fullText.traditional:
第29章、抓住他

    變裝成周局長的藏花開槍打碎了裝佛像的玻璃櫃，然後飛快地往樓下跑去了。
    樓下馬上響起一片碰撞聲和驚叫聲：“周局長，怎麼了？誰開的槍？”
    “是藏花！藏花跑了！快去追！”
    混亂中，一群人看到周局長在向外跑，他們也沒弄清楚發生了什麼事，就跟著向外跑。但剛跑到院門口，又是一聲“砰”響，有人站在院子外面開槍了！
    大家站住了一看，院子外面開槍的也是周局長！
    每個人都愣住了，他們前面站著一個周局長，院子外面也站著一個周局長，兩個周局長！
    包厚安已經追了出來，他跑到人群前，指著院子裡的這個周局長大聲喊：“抓住他！他是藏花！”
    這一聲喊讓大家清醒了，“他是藏花，抓住他！”大家也大喊著，一起撲上去抓藏花。
    “小心，他有槍！”包厚安也衝了過去。
    十多個人和藏花打成一片，叫喊聲也響成一片。混亂中，又是“砰”地一聲，打成一片的人群中傳出一聲槍響，撲打在一起的人馬上後退著散開了。
    散開後的空地上，藏花站在那兒。他右手拿著槍，左手抓著一個人，槍指在那個人的頭上，大聲說：“所有人讓開，不然我就開槍了！”
    他抓的人是包厚安。他在混亂中抓住了包厚安。
    散開的警察們措手不及地愣住了，你看看我，我看看你，不知道怎麼辦。
    白林站在遠處，大聲說：“藏花！如果包厚安傷了一根頭髮，你要用命來還！”
    院子外面的周局長也氣極了，大聲喊：“藏花，你放開他！”
    藏花笑了笑，沒有說話，他一手抓著包厚安，一手握著槍，往院子外面走去。
    包厚安的臉是紅色的，因為緊張，也因為興奮。現在藏花就在身邊，離得這麼近，這是最好的抓他的機會！在對手沒有防備的情況下出其不意地進攻，讓對手措手不及，這是藏花最喜歡做的事情，現在也是包厚安最想做的事情。
    包厚安深吸一口氣，用力撞向藏花，然後飛快地轉身撲向他！
    藏花一愣，想往後躲，但已經來不及了。他被撞得後退了幾步，還沒站穩又被包厚安撲倒了，兩個人一起倒在了地上。藏花急紅了臉，想推開包厚安，但包厚安死死地將他抱住了。槍還握在藏花手裡，但他只是握著，並沒有開槍。
    周圍的人也撲了上來，有人抓手，有人抓腳，將藏花死死地按住了。

sentences.simplified: 两个人一起倒在了地上。
sentences.traditional: 兩個人一起倒在了地上。
sentences.pinyin: liǎng ge rén yì qǐ dǎo zài le dì shang
sentences.english: They both fell to the ground together.

sentences.simplified: 藏花急红了脸，想推开包厚安，但包厚安死死地将他抱住了。
sentences.traditional: 藏花急紅了臉，想推開包厚安，但包厚安死死地將他抱住了。
sentences.pinyin: cáng huā jí hóng le liǎn xiǎng tuī kāi bāo hòu ān dàn bāo hòu ān sǐ sǐ de jiāng tā bào zhù le
sentences.english: Cang Hua’s face turned red. He wanted to push Bao Houan away, but Bao Houan held him down firmly.

sentences.simplified: 枪还握在藏花手里，但他只是握着，并没有开枪。
sentences.traditional: 槍還握在藏花手裡，但他只是握著，並沒有開槍。
sentences.pinyin: qiāng hái wò zài cáng huā shǒu lǐ dàn tā zhǐ shì wò zhe bìng méi yǒu kāi qiāng
sentences.english: The gun was still in Cang Hua’s hand, but he only held onto it. He didn’t shoot.

sentences.simplified: 周围的人也扑了上来，有人抓手，有人抓脚，将藏花死死地按住了。
sentences.traditional: 周圍的人也撲了上來，有人抓手，有人抓腳，將藏花死死地按住了。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu wéi de rén yě pū le shàng lái yǒu rén zhuā shǒu yǒu rén zhuā jiǎo jiāng cáng huā sǐ sǐ de àn zhù le
sentences.english: People around also rushed forward. Some people grabbed his hands, and some people grabbed his feet, pinning Cang Hua firmly down.

sentence_translations: Chapter 29: Grab Him
Disguised as Police Chief Zhou, Cang Hua fired a shot that shattered the glass cabinet holding the Buddha statue, ..
.. then quickly ran downstairs.
Immediately, a flurry of collision sounds and screams came from downstairs: “Police Chief Zhou, what happened? Who fired the gun?”
“It’s Cang Hua! Cang Hua is on the run! Quickly go chase him!”
In the chaos, a group of people saw Police Chief Zhou running out. Without understanding what had happened, they also followed and ran out.
But just as they reached the gate to the yard, another “bang” sounded. Someone was shooting from outside the yard!
Everybody stood and looked. The person outside the gate who opened fire was also Police Chief Zhou!
Everyone was stunned. There was a Police Chief Zhou standing in front of them and another Police Chief Zhou standing outside in the yard.
There were two Police Chief Zhous!
Bao Houan had already caught up.
He ran up to the crowd, pointed at the Police Chief Zhou inside the yard, and loudly yelled, “Grab him! It’s Cang Hua!”
This woke everyone up. “It’s Cang Hua, grab him!” everyone also yelled, and they rushed over together to capture Cang Hua.
“Careful, he has a gun!” Bao Houan also rushed over.
More than ten people tangled with Cang Hua, and their shouts became a cacophony.
In the chaos, there was another “bang” sound.
A gunshot echoed within the crowd, causing the tangled crowd to immediately retreat and disperse.
Cang Hua stood on the empty ground after the crowd dispersed.
His right hand held his gun, and his left hand grabbed a person. The gun was pointed at that person’s head.
He said loudly, “Everyone back off, or I’ll shoot!”
The person he was grabbing was Bao Houan. In the confusion, he had got hold of Bao Houan.
The scattered police officers were caught unprepared and stood there stunned. They looked at each other, not knowing what to do.
Bai Lin stood at a distance and said loudly, “Cang Hua! If a single hair on Bao Houan’s head is harmed, you will pay with your life!”
Outside the yard, Police Chief Zhou was also extremely angry. He loudly shouted, “Cang Hua, let him go!”
Cang Hua laughed and didn’t say anything. With one hand grabbing Bao Houan and another holding the gun, he headed outside the yard.
Bao Houan’s face was red because he was nervous and also because he was excited.
Cang Hua was now beside him. He was so close. This was the best opportunity to catch him!
Catching his opponent off guard by an unexpected attack was something that Cang Hua loved to do.
Right now, it was also what Bao Houan wanted to do the most.
Bao Houan took a deep breath, forcefully collided with Cang Hua, then quickly turned around and lunged at him!
Cang Hua was stunned. He tried to retreat, but it was already too late.
He was knocked back a few steps by the impact, and before he could regain his balance, he was tackled to the ground by Bao Houan.
They both fell to the ground together.
Cang Hua’s face turned red. He wanted to push Bao Houan away, but Bao Houan held him down firmly.
The gun was still in Cang Hua’s hand, but he only held onto it. He didn’t shoot.
People around also rushed forward. Some people grabbed his hands, and some people grabbed his feet, pinning Cang Hua firmly down.
